record.paper_title: Open questions in descriptive set theory and dynamical systems
record.context_brief: Measures of maximal entropy on T^2
record.original_question: For every smooth mixing map f ∈ C∞(T^2, T^2), is the measure of maximal entropy fully supported?

evidence.quote: Question 2.6 (García-Ramos). Is the measure of maximal entropy fully supported for every smooth mixing map on the torus (f ∈ C∞(Π2, Π2))?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{T}^2 = \mathbb{R}^2/\mathbb{Z}^2$ denote the two-dimensional torus, and let $f: \mathbb{T}^2 \to \mathbb{T}^2$ be a smooth (i.e. $C^\infty$) map. Recall that $f$ is said to be topologically mixing if for every pair of non-empty open sets $U, V \subseteq \mathbb{T}^2$ there exists $N \in \mathbb{N}$ such that $f^{-n}(U) \cap V \neq \emptyset$ for all $n \geq N$. The topological entropy $h_{\mathrm{top}}(f)$ is defined as usual, and a measure of maximal entropy is an $f$-invariant Borel probability measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{T}^2$ with measure-theoretic entropy $h_\mu(f) = h_{\mathrm{top}}(f)$. Such a measure $\mu$ is said to be fully supported if $\operatorname{supp}(\mu) = \mathbb{T}^2$.

Question: Is it true that for every smooth topologically mixing map $f \in C^\infty(\mathbb{T}^2, \mathbb{T}^2)$, every measure of maximal entropy of $f$ is fully supported?
artifact.category_tag: measures of maximal entropy on the torus
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of the question was found. The question is posed as an open problem attributed to García-Ramos, and web search returned only related results on uniqueness/support of measures of maximal entropy in different settings (piecewise hyperbolic maps, geodesic flows, surface automorphisms), none of which resolves the general smooth mixing case on $\mathbb{T}^2$.

status_evidence.title: Uniqueness of the measure of maximal entropy for the standard map
status_evidence.snippet: Studies uniqueness/support of MME for specific torus maps, not the general smooth mixing case.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature treats specific torus maps but does not resolve the general smooth mixing question.

status_evidence.title: Automorphisms of surfaces: Kummer rigidity and measure of maximal entropy
status_evidence.snippet: Treats MME for surface automorphisms; not the general C^infty mixing torus map case.
status_evidence.claim: No general statement covering all smooth mixing torus maps appears in the literature found.
